blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Embodied systems must make knowledge acquired during one encounter usable in another despite changes in viewpoint, motion, and illumination.
Yet aggregate cross-video accuracy conflates failures of local perception with failures to preserve observation identity, establish correspondence, and compose evidence, obscuring whether local video understanding actually transfers.
We introduce EgoGears , a complementary single- and multi-video benchmark designed to diagnose this transition.
It contains 567 567 single-video and 1,487 1{,}487 multi-video questions derived from 126 126 human-collected egocentric recordings covering 39 39 outdoor routes.
Repeated traversals across movement speeds and lighting conditions ground comparisons in shared physical environments; 531 531 questions require alignment across independent recordings.
Single-video questions measure the local visual, spatial, and motion evidence available to a model, while multi-video questions test whether evidence remains bound to the correct observation and can be composed into consistent route relationships.
We report 29 29 single-video and 31 31 multi-video MLLM configurations across six model families in the main leaderboard.
Among the 20 20 configurations evaluated comparably on both splits, every model performs worse on multi-video questions, with a mean decrease of 22.5 22.5 percentage points, and the gap persists when answer format and scoring are held fixed.
The gap is not explained simply by additional videos or recording boundaries. The central bottlenecks are observation–evidence binding and ordered route-state tracking.
EgoGears provides a diagnostic testbed for understanding when, why, and how local video understanding fails to transfer across encounters.
The code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/lei-qi-233/EgoGears

我们引入了EgoGears, 一个互补的单一和多视频基准 旨在诊断这种转变。
它包含567,567个单视频和1,487 1{,}487个多视频问题,来自126,126个人集自负心的录音,覆盖了39个户外路线.

EgoGears提供了一个诊断测试台,用于了解何时,为什么,以及当地视频理解如何未能跨相遇传递.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in video understanding, including long-form question answering, temporal reasoning, and egocentric activity understanding ( Fan, 2019 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Peng et al., 2026 ; Plizzari et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . For outdoor embodied AI, a consequential next step is to make knowledge acquired during one encounter usable in another.
An agent may revisit a junction from the opposite direction, encounter a familiar landmark under different illumination, or compare its current journey with a previously observed route. Successful interpretation requires connecting observations that differ in appearance while preserving distinctions between places, travel directions, and events.
A model must determine what remains the same, what has changed, and which experience supports each conclusion. Cross-video comparison thus probes a capability central to embodied intelligence: constructing a consistent understanding of the world from separate, partial encounters.
blocks.zh:
近期多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)在视频理解上取得了快速进展,包括长形式问题解答,时间推理,以及自我中心活动理解(Fan, 2019;Li等;Peng等;Plizzari等;2025;Chen等;2026). 对于户外的人工智能,随后的下一步是使在一次接触中获得的知识可用于另一次接触。
代理人可能从相反的方向重访一个相接点,在不同发光下会遇到一个熟悉的地标,或者将其目前的旅程与先前观察到的路线相提并论. 成功的解释需要将不同外观的观察联系起来,同时保留地点、旅行方向和事件之间的区别。
一个模式必须确定什么是不变的,什么是变化的,什么经验支持每个结论. 因此,交叉视频比较探索了一种能够体现智能的核心能力:从单独的、局部的相会中构建对世界的一致理解。

blocks.en:
Human-collected egocentric videos provide a grounded setting for investigating this capability.
Our study uses recordings of people walking, jogging, and running along outdoor routes, with repeated traversals across movement speeds and lighting conditions.
These recordings capture how bodily movement shapes visual evidence: turns change ego-relative directions, speed changes the temporal spacing between landmarks, and return journeys reverse their order of appearance.
Repeated observations of the same routes anchor these variations to a shared physical environment.
This setting requires models to relate observations through environmental structure while accounting for the circumstances of each encounter.
Its relevance extends to embodied systems that must interpret human route demonstrations, recognize previously visited places, or connect current observations with earlier experience.
blocks.zh:
人们聚集的以自我为中心的视频为调查这种能力提供了一个有根据的环境。
我们的研究用录音记录人们步行,慢跑,沿着户外路线跑来跑去,反复穿越移动速度和照明条件.
这些录音记录了身体运动如何塑造视觉证据:改变自我相对方向,速度改变地标之间的时间间隔,回程颠倒了外观顺序.
同一路线的多次观测使这些变化与共同的物质环境相连接。
这种设定要求模型通过环境结构将观测联系起来,同时考虑每次接触的情况。
其相关性扩大到必须解释人行道演示、承认以前访问过的地方或将目前的观察与以前的经验相连接的系统。

blocks.en:
The distinctive contribution of our study lies in combining human egocentric motion, repeated outdoor traversals, and complementary single- and multi-video evaluation .
Existing benchmarks have advanced local perception, temporal understanding, and reasoning across extended experiences ( Fan, 2019 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Plizzari et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
Our focus is the relationship between these levels of competence: does understanding individual observations support consistent reasoning across observations? The single-video component assesses the local visual, spatial, and motion evidence available to a model.
The multi-video component examines whether the model can retain observation identity, establish correspondence across separate recordings, and compose evidence into relationships among landmarks, directions, and route segments.
Consider a runner returning at dusk along a route previously recorded in daylight. At an unfamiliar-looking junction, the runner asks: “Did I pass this junction earlier, and which landmark should appear next on the way back?” A wearable assistant would need to compare the current observation with the earlier recording, recognize the junction despite changes in illumination and viewing direction, identify the return phase, and infer the reversed landmark sequence.
Recognizing objects in each video independently would leave these relationships unresolved. Together, these evaluations support a more informative assessment of cross-video competence than aggregate accuracy alone.
Cross-video errors may stem from local perception, evidence misattribution, failed correspondence, or reasoning over aligned observations. Evaluating these capabilities jointly helps the community identify where improvement is needed.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究的显著贡献在于结合人类自我中心运动、重复的户外穿行以及互补的单一和多视频评价。
现有的基准提高了地方感知,时间理解,以及跨越长期经验的推理(Fan,2019;Li等,2026b;Plizzari等,2025;Chen等,2026).
我们的重点是这些级别权限之间的关系:理解个别观察是否支持各种观察的一致推理? 单一视频部分评估一个模型可用的局部视觉、空间和运动证据。
多视频部分审查该模型是否能够保留观测身份,建立不同录音之间的通信,并将证据编成地标、方向和路线段之间的关系。
考虑一个在黄昏返回的跑者 沿着先前在白天记录的路线 在不熟悉的交叉口,跑者问道:“我早些时候是否经过过这个交叉口,在返回的路上应该出现哪个地标?” 可穿戴的助理需要将目前的观察与更早的录音进行比较,尽管照明和取景方向有所改变,但仍要识别交叉口,确定返回阶段,并推断倒转的地标顺序.
独立识别每段视频中的物体,将使这种关系得不到解决。 这些评价加在一起有助于对跨视频能力进行比总体准确性更翔实的评估。
交叉视频出错可能出自于局部感知,证据误入歧途,函证失败,或对对齐观测的推理. 共同评估这些能力有助于社区确定哪些方面需要改进。

blocks.en:
We introduce EgoGears , a benchmark that examines whether models can preserve the identity and context of visual evidence when reasoning across outdoor experiences. It comprises 567 567 single-video questions and 1,487 1{,}487 multi-video comparison questions derived from 126 126 human-collected egocentric recordings covering 39 39 outdoor routes and 22.6 22.6 hours.
Repeated traversals across movement speeds and lighting conditions anchor changes in appearance and motion to shared physical environments.
The benchmark connects three evaluation targets: local understanding , evidence integration , and cross-recording correspondence , all in high-motion walking and running footage.
Single-video questions assess objects and attributes, ego-relative spatial relations, ego-motion, trajectories, and temporal events.
Multi-video questions require models to associate evidence with the correct clip, integrate non-contiguous observations, recognize corresponding places and route phases, compare travel directions, identify shared paths, and localize route divergence.
Of these, 531 531 questions require alignment across independent recordings.
blocks.zh:

反复穿越移动速度和照明条件,使外观和运动改变为共享的物质环境。
该基准连接了三个评价目标:当地理解、证据整合和交叉记录的通信,都包含在高调行走和运行的镜头中。
单视频问题评估物体和属性,自我-相对空间关系,自我-运动,轨迹,以及时间事件.
多视频问题需要模型将证据与正确的剪辑联系起来,整合非相接观测,识别相应的地点和路由阶段,比较出行方向,识别共享路径,将路由差异本地化.
其中531,531个问题需要经过独立的录音。

blocks.en:
The question design makes the relationship between an observation and its context central to evaluation.
Questions combine an observation target, a temporal or route-phase condition, and a relation to infer, with answers grounded in specified evidence windows.
Distractors introduce targeted perturbations to visually supported content, including directional reversals, temporal-order changes, route-phase mismatches, and incorrect attribution of landmarks or events.
Resolving these alternatives requires identifying not only which facts are present, but where, when, and to which observation they belong.
Variable-cardinality multi-select questions further require models to recover the complete supported answer set.
Complementary input-structure and capability axes organize questions by how evidence is distributed and what reasoning it demands; five input-structure units span evidence within one recording through correspondence across recordings.
Together with the single-video assessment, this design supports investigating whether difficulties arise in recovering local evidence or in preserving and composing it across observations.
Deterministic option shuffling, metadata anonymization, text-only shortcut screening, video-grounded verification, and human review strengthen the connection between benchmark performance and visual evidence.
blocks.zh:
问题设计使观察与其背景之间的关系成为评价的核心。
问题将观察目标、时间或路由相条件以及与推断的关系与基于特定证据窗口的答案结合起来。
干扰器将定向扰动引入视觉支持的内容,包括方向倒转,时间顺序变化,路由相错配,地标或事件归属不正确等.
解决这些替代办法不仅需要确定哪些事实存在,而且需要查明它们属于何处、何时和属于何种观察。
可变心动多选题进一步需要模型来回收完整的被支持的答案集.
补充性输入结构和能力轴按证据如何分配和它需要什么推理来组织提问;五个输入结构单元通过跨记录的函证在一次记录中跨出证据.
与单一视频评估一起,这一设计有助于调查在寻找当地证据或保存和综合各种观测数据方面是否出现困难。
断断续续的选项打乱,元数据匿名化,文本专用快捷筛选,视频定位验证,人文审查等加强了基准性能与视觉证据之间的联系.

blocks.en:
We report 29 29 single-video and 31 31 multi-video MLLM configurations spanning six model families in the main leaderboard.
Our evaluation reveals persistent difficulties with clip–evidence association and ordered route reasoning, with the strongest overall multi-video configuration reaching only 33.3 % 33.3\% on multi-step turning over whole-video evidence (Table 6 ).
Across the eight matched single-video comparisons in the main leaderboard, enabling explicit reasoning improves every configuration by a median of 7.8 7.8 percentage points, but the gains are substantially larger for ego-relative spatial relations than for trajectory-grounded questions ( 14.0 14.0 versus 3.7 3.7 points), suggesting that stronger evidence verification does not translate uniformly into better understanding of movement and route structure.
Our contributions are threefold: • We formulate cross-video understanding for outdoor embodied AI around evidence binding, correspondence, and spatiotemporal composition. Joint single- and multi-video evaluation examines whether local understanding supports consistent reasoning across encounters. • We introduce EgoGears : 567 567 single-video and 1,487 1{,}487 multi-video questions from 126 126 human-collected egocentric recordings across 39 39 outdoor routes, including 531 531 questions requiring correspondence across independent recordings. Repeated traversals, relational distractors, and exact-set scoring probe evidence consistency across changes in movement speed and illumination. • We report 29 29 single-video and 31 31 multi-video configurations across six MLLM families, revealing bottlenecks in evidence binding and ordered route reasoning. Across eight matched single-video comparisons, reasoning improves every configuration (median gain: 7.8 7.8 percentage points), with smaller gains for trajectory understanding than ego-relative spatial reasoning.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Egocentric Video QA Benchmarks. Egocentric video understanding has progressed from action understanding (EgoVQA ( Fan, 2019 ) and EgoTaskQA ( Jia et al., 2022 ) ) to long-video temporal memory (EgoTempo ( Plizzari et al., 2025 ) ) and object-interaction topology (AMEGO ( Goletto et al., 2025 ) ), yet route-level spatial reasoning under highly dynamic outdoor motion remains underexplored. Spatial QA benchmarks, including NuScenes-QA ( Qian et al., 2024 ) , SpatialBench ( Xu et al., 2025b ) , and MMSI-Video-Bench ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , incorporate outdoor scenes or 3D geometry but primarily rely on vehicle trajectories, third-person views, or static scenes. EgoCross ( Li et al., 2026b ) covers extreme sports but remains limited to single clips. Regarding input scope, EgoThink ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) uses single video sources, while Ego-Exo4D ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) and EgoExoMem ( Liu et al., 2026 ) support synchronized multi-view reasoning. EgoMonth ( Chen et al., 2026 ) extends reasoning across videos and days but mainly targets routine activities. However, they do not directly test whether knowledge acquired in one encounter remains spatially and temporally coherent when the same physical environment is revisited under different viewpoints, directions, speeds, or illumination.
EgoGears targets this gap by pairing single-video understanding with cross-recording correspondence over repeated outdoor traversals.
blocks.zh:
偏执 视频QA 基准。 爱果心视频理解从动作理解(EgoVQA (Fan, 2019)和EgoTaskQA (Jia等, 2022))到长视频时间记忆(EgoTempo (Plizzari等, 2025))和物体交互地貌(AMEGO (Goletto等, 2025))都有所进展,然而在高度动态室外运动下的路由级空间推理仍然未得到充分探索. 空间QA基准,包括NuScenes-QA(Qian等,2024年),Space Bench(徐等,2025年b)和MMSI-Video-Bench(Lin等,2025年),包含户外场景或3D几何,但主要依靠车辆轨迹,第三人称视角,或静态场景. EgoCross(Li等,2026b.)涵盖极端运动,但仍限于单片. 关于输入范围,EgoThink(Cheng等,2024年)使用单相视频源,而Ego-Exo4D(Grauman等,2024年)和EgoExoMem(Liu等,2026年)支持同步多视图推理. EgoMonth(Chen等,2026年)将推理延伸至视频和天数,但主要针对日常活动. 然而,当同一个物理环境在不同的观点、方向、速度或发光下重新审视时,它们并不直接检验在一次接触中获得的知识在空间和时间上是否一致。
EgoGears通过将单视频理解与交叉记录的通信对准重复的室外穿行来达到这一差距.

blocks.en:
Multimodal Large Language Models. MLLMs increasingly rely on key-frame selection and token compression to process long, highly dynamic videos ( Shi et al., 2025a ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2026 ; Wen et al., 2026 ) . General-purpose open-source models, including InternVL ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , MiniCPM ( Hu et al., 2024 ) , and Qwen-Omni ( Xu et al., 2025a ) , alongside egocentric models such as EgoVLPv2 ( Pramanick et al., 2023 ) and EgoGPT ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , have advanced dynamic visual representation. Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025a ) further supports ultra-long sequences through Interleaved-MRoPE and explicit text-based temporal alignment. Commercial Gemini models, including Gemini 3.1 Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2026a ) , provide strong general-purpose reasoning baselines and are included in our evaluation. Recent MLLMs nevertheless struggle with physical spatiotemporal and multi-video reasoning ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , and most open-source MLLMs lack comprehensive cross-video reasoning training. Frame sampling and token compression can discard spatial landmarks essential for continuous state tracking ( Shi et al., 2025b ; Shi et al., 2025a ) , while outdoor lighting changes exacerbate hallucinations and reliance on language priors ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhuang et al., 2026 ) . Under degraded visibility, misalignment between these priors and visual evidence, or indiscriminate suppression of the priors, can further disrupt semantic consistency and state tracking.
We therefore report 29 single-video and 31 multi-video configurations in the main leaderboard to assess highly dynamic state tracking, environmental robustness, and asynchronous cross-video reasoning. For configurations evaluated in comparable modes, multi-video accuracy is consistently lower than single-video accuracy, also when answer format and scoring are held fixed. The results motivate closer analysis of evidence binding and ordered route reasoning without attributing the observed difference to the number of videos alone.
blocks.zh:
多式联运大语言模型. MLLMs越来越依赖键框选择和符号压缩来处理长而活泼的视频(Shi等,2025a; Jiang等,2025;Peng等,2026;Wen等,2026.). 普通用途开源模型,包括InternVL(Zhu等,2025年),MiniCPM (Hu等, 2024),和Quen-Omni (Xu等, 2025a),与EgoVLPv2(Pramanick等, 2023)和EgoGPT(Yang等, 2025)等以自我为中心的模型一起,具有先进的动态视觉表现. Quen3-VL (Bai等, 2025a.)通过Interleaved-MROPE和明确的文本时间对接,进一步支持超长序列. 商业双子座模型,包括双子座3.1 Pro(Google DeepMind,2026a.),提供了强大的通用推理基线,并被纳入我们的评价. 不过,最近的MLLMs与物理空间和多视频推理(Lin等,2025年)相搏,大多数开源的MLLMs缺乏全面的跨视频推理训练. 框架采样和符号压缩可以丢弃持续状态跟踪所必需的空间地标(Shi等,2025b;Shi等,2025a),而户外照明变化会加剧幻觉并依赖语言前传(Wu等,2025; Zhu等,2026). 在可见度下降的情况下,这些前科和视觉证据之间的错位,或者不加区分地压制前科,会进一步破坏语义一致性和状态跟踪.
因此,我们报告29个单视频和31个多视频配置在主领导板上,以评估高动态状态跟踪,环境稳健性,同步交叉视频推理. 对于以可比较模式评价的配置,多视频精度始终低于单视频精度,在回答格式和评分保持固定时也是如此. 其结果促使人们更仔细地分析证据的约束力和命令的路由推理,而不把观察到的差异仅仅归因于视频的数量。

blocks.en: 3 EgoGears Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 电子游戏数据集

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes how EgoGears is built. We record 126 126 egocentric videos over 39 39 outdoor routes at three movement speeds (slow walking, fast walking, and running) and two lighting conditions (day and night); coverage varies by route (Section 3.3 ). EgoGears-Single and EgoGears-Multi are generated along separate paths and screened by automated quality gates. The candidates then pass through human review and post-review adjudication, which yields 567 567 single-video and 1,487 1{,}487 multi-video QA pairs. We first describe the QA design principles shared by both subsets (Sec. 3.1 ).
blocks.zh: 图1总结了EgoGears的构建方式. 我们在39个户外路线上录取126个以自我为中心的录像, EgoGears-Single和EgoGears-Multi都是按照不同的路径生成的,并通过自动化质量门进行筛选. 考生随后通过人文审查和后文审核裁定,结果产生567 567个单相视频和1,487 1{,}487个多相视频QA对相. 我们首先描述了两个子集共同的质量保证设计原则(第3.1节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 QA Pairs Design
blocks.zh: 3.1 质量保证对等设计

blocks.en: Design Objective and Task Scope. This study targets first-person outdoor high-dynamic video understanding, primarily focusing on walking, fast walking, and running scenarios. These videos inherently contain continuous camera displacement, viewpoint changes, motion-induced instability, and dynamic external entities. Under varying controlled conditions (e.g., changes in illumination and movement speed), the same route may exhibit different visual characteristics. Unlike traditional video QA that focuses on static scene summarization or isolated frame recognition, our central objective is to assess whether models can form a local, continuous-temporal, and cross-clip understanding of first-person routes. Questions require models to connect visual entities with their temporal position, spatial relation, route phase, and motion state. The model must determine not only what appears, but when it appears, its relative position to the walking path, and its order in the route structure, demonstrating a structured spatiotemporal representation of the dynamic environment.
blocks.zh: 设计目标和任务范围。 本研究针对第一人称户外高动态视频理解,主要关注步行,快行走,跑跑情景. 这些视频内在包含连续相机转移、观点变化、运动引起的不稳定以及动态外部实体。 在不同的受控条件下(例如:照明和运动速度的变化),同一条路线可能表现出不同的视觉特征. 与传统以静态场景总结或孤立帧识别为重点的视频QA不同,我们的中心目标是评估模型是否能够形成局部,连续的时态,并交叉对第一人称路线的理解. 问题需要模型将视觉实体与其时间位置,空间关系,路由相和运动状态相接. 该模型不仅必须确定出现什么,而且在出现时,它与行走道的相对位置,以及它在行走道结构中的顺序,显示动态环境的结构化的瞬间表现.

blocks.en: Principles of Question Construction. Every question must be traceable to defined video evidence windows. A question generally encodes three hierarchical levels of information: Observation Target , indicating specific entities such as buildings, vehicles, or pedestrians; Observation Condition , defining contextual constraints like specific time intervals, points before or after a turn, or outbound versus return legs; and Inferred Relation , specifying the reasoning objective, such as presence, relative direction, sequence, or cross-video correspondence. This structure ensures the task measures visually grounded spatiotemporal reasoning rather than text-based memorization. To achieve this, visual facts are transformed into discriminative relations to prevent models from relying on coarse scene-level categorization. For instance, rather than asking if an object exists, questions ask which objects appear after a right turn , or the sequence of passed landmarks. Spatial relations emphasize relative metrics (left/right, ahead/behind) based on the camera wearer’s trajectory, while dynamic entities are distinguished by their behavior (e.g., approaching, overtaking, crossing). Furthermore, questions scale in difficulty by utilizing single continuous clips, multiple non-contiguous windows, or complete route stages. This gradient tests the model’s ability to transition from local observation to long-temporal reasoning. Crucially, the provided evidence windows must jointly cover the asked relation; questions requiring unobservable context are excluded from deterministic evaluation.
blocks.zh: 问题建筑原则。 每个问题都必须可以追踪到定义的视频证据窗口. 一个问题一般对三个层次的信息进行编码: 观察目标,指出建筑物、车辆或行人等具体实体; 观察条件,界定背景限制,如特定的时间间隔、转弯前或后点,或出弯与回弯腿; 推断关系,具体说明推理目标,如存在、相对方向、顺序或交叉视频通信。 这一结构确保了任务衡量以视为根据的瞬间推理,而不是以文字为基础的记忆。 为了实现这一点,视觉事实被转化为歧视关系来防止模型依赖粗糙的场景级别分类. 例如,问题不是询问对象是否存在,而是询问哪个对象在右转后出现,或者经过地标的顺序. 空间关系强调基于相机穿戴者轨迹的相对度量(左/右,前/后),而动态实体则根据其行为(如接近,超越,跨越)来区分. 此外,通过使用单个连续接发、多个非相接的窗口或完整的路由阶段,问题规模在困难之中。 这种梯度测试了模型从局部观察向长期推理过渡的能力. 重要的是,所提供的证据窗口必须共同涵盖被询问的关系;需要不可观察背景的问题被排除在确定性评价之外。

blocks.en: Option and Answer Design. EgoGears employs structured, letter-based closed-set options. For multiple-choice formats, a response is strictly evaluated based on the complete set of correct options. This design forces the model to perform both evidence-support and evidence-exclusion judgments simultaneously, ensuring it identifies all relevant visual evidence rather than stopping at one salient cue. Distractors are engineered as near-miss statements that apply controlled perturbations to entities genuinely present in the video, preventing models from guessing answers based on noun-matching or surface-level syntactic cues. Key perturbation strategies include spatial and directional reversals (e.g., swapping left/right or reversing turn directions), temporal and phase mismatches (e.g., reversing event order or incorrectly applying an outbound observation to a return leg), entity state confusion (e.g., confusing a parked object with a moving one, or altering the direction of motion), and subject-relation reassignment (e.g., pairing a legitimate landmark with the wrong building or action). All options are normalized for length, syntax, and information density. Ultimately, answer judgment is deeply grounded in visual evidence, explicitly distinguishing between a definitively incorrect statement and an indeterminate one. If a distractor incorrectly claims a spatial or temporal state, it is marked incorrect. However, if the video footage simply lacks the evidence to verify an option (e.g., a landmark is absent from a specific short clip but may exist in the broader unshown route), the option is not forced into the incorrect category, ensuring the evaluation remains strictly deterministic.
blocks.zh: 选项和答案设计。 EgoGears使用结构化的,以字母为基础的闭合设置选项. 对于多选择格式,根据一整套正确的选项严格评价一个响应. 这种设计迫使模型同时进行证据支持和证据排除判决,确保它能够识别所有相关的视觉证据,而不是停留在一个显著的提示上。 干扰器被设计为对视频中真正存在的实体施加受控扰动的近乎失传的语句,防止模型根据名词匹配或地平面同步提示来猜测答案. 关键扰动策略包括:空间和方向倒转(如左/右相倒转或倒转转方向),时间和相位不匹配(如倒转事件顺序或错误地将外向的观察应用到回放地段),实体状态混乱(如将停放物体与移动物体相混淆,或改变运动方向),以及主题关系重置(如将合法的地标与错误的建筑或动作相配). 所有选项在长度,语法,信息密度方面都实现了正常化. 最终,答案判断深深地以视觉证据为基础,明确区分明确不正确的陈述和不确定的陈述。 如果分心者错误地声称空间状态或时间状态,则它被标记为不正确. 然而,如果视频片段只是缺乏验证一个选项的证据(例如,特定短片中缺少一个地标,但可能在更宽广的不明路线中存在),则该选项不会被强制进入不正确的类别,确保评价仍然严格地具有决定性意义.

blocks.en: The EgoGears QA design establishes a multi-granular evaluation framework centered on visual-evidence-driven first-person route understanding. By combining structured spatiotemporal relations, closed-set answer evaluations, and visually perturbed distractors, the design transcends basic video captioning. It robustly challenges models to decode the complex interplay of route trajectory, observer viewpoint, continuous time, and external dynamics.
blocks.zh: EgoGears QA设计建立了以视觉-证据驱动的第一人称路由理解为核心的多角度评价框架. 通过将结构分明的spatiotial关系,闭合集解答评价,和视觉扰动分心器结合起来,设计超越了基本的视频字幕. 它有力地挑战各种模型,以解码路线轨迹、观察者观点、持续时间和外部动态的复杂相互作用。

blocks.en: 3.2 Collection Methodology
blocks.zh: 3.2 收集方法

blocks.en: Human-collected route observations. We collect human egocentric recordings of outdoor routes across movement speeds and day/night illumination. Routes include distinctive landmarks and diverse turn structures while minimizing incidental pedestrian capture. Repeated and out-and-back traversals provide observations of shared physical structure under changes in viewpoint, travel direction, motion, and lighting. Condition coverage varies across routes, as reported in Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 人类收集的路线观测. 我们收集人类以自我为中心 记录户外路线 跨越移动速度和昼夜照明。 路线包括有特色的地标和多样的转弯结构,同时尽量减少偶然的行人被俘. 反复和外向倒转可观察在视线、行走方向、运动和照明的变化下共有的物理结构。 如第3.3节所报告,不同路线的条件覆盖范围各不相同。

blocks.en:
Evidence-grounded question generation. MLLMs extract structured observations of landmarks, turns, route phases, spatial relations, and events to generate candidate questions. EgoGears-Single uses continuous 60 60 -second clips, including shorter tail clips, to assess local understanding. EgoGears-Multi combines whole-recording or segment-level observations and, where required, independent recordings to assess route-phase alignment, landmark correspondence, event attribution, and route divergence.
Questions associate a visual target with an observation or route-phase condition and require inferring a spatial, temporal, or cross-observation relation. Relational distractors perturb direction, ordering, route phase, entity state, or evidence attribution.
blocks.zh:
以证据为根据的提问生成. MLLMs提取地标,转弯,路由相位,空间关系等结构化观测结果,以及事件生成候选问题. EgoGears-Single使用连续60-秒的剪辑,包括更短的尾片剪辑来评估本地的理解. EgoGears-Multi将全程记录或分段观测结合起来,并在必要时进行独立记录,以评估路由相接、划时代的通信、事件归属和路由差异。
问题将视觉目标与观测或路由相位条件联系起来,并需要推断出空间、时间或交叉观测关系。 关系分心器干扰方向,订单,路由相,实体状态,或证据归属.

blocks.en: Preserving observation boundaries. Each question is linked to its source recordings and evidence windows. Non-contiguous excerpts and clips from different recordings remain separate inputs, preserving the observation boundaries needed for evidence binding. Evaluation clips use 480p H.264 video without audio, and anonymized identifiers conceal recording metadata.
blocks.zh: 保留观察界限。 每个问题都与其来源录音和证据窗口相连。 不同录音的非相接性摘录和剪辑仍然是单独的输入,保留了证据约束所需的观察界限. 评价片段使用没有音频的480p H.264视频,匿名识别码隐藏了记录元数据.

blocks.en:
Verification and review. Text-only screening flags potentially guessable questions, while video-grounded verification evaluates options as supported, ruled_out, or undecidable. Multi-clip and cross-video candidates additionally undergo checks for comparison requirements, evidence availability, duplication, and metadata leakage; deterministic shuffling controls option-position and clip-order cues.
Human reviewers assess question clarity and option validity. Multi-video reviewers additionally construct separate clip timelines and assess correspondence using stable physical structure rather than transient appearance.
Adjudication combines reviewer judgments with further visual and text-only checks; repaired questions are rechecked, and unresolved cases are removed. The pipeline yields 567 567 single-video and 1,487 1{,}487 multi-video questions. Acquisition settings, model roles, screening procedures, and review coverage are detailed in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
核查和审查。 仅文本筛选标记可能存在可猜的问题,而以视频为基础的校验则将选项评价为支持,排除,或不可解析. 多剪辑和跨视频候选人还接受比较要求、证据可得性、重复和元数据渗漏的检查;确定性打乱控制选项位置和剪辑顺序提示。
人文审查者评估问题清晰度和选项有效性. 多视频审查员另外构建了单独的剪辑时间表,并使用稳定的物理结构而不是瞬间外观来评估通信。
裁判结合审阅员判断,进一步进行目视检查和文字检查;对修复后的问题进行再检查,删除未解决的案件. 管道输出567 567个单视频和1 487 1{,}487个多视频问题。 采购设置、示范作用、筛选程序和审查范围详见附录C。

blocks.en: 3.3 Dataset Composition
blocks.zh: 3.3 数据集组成

blocks.en: EgoGears evaluates local video understanding and cross-video reasoning using human-collected outdoor egocentric recordings spanning different movement speeds and lighting conditions. Figure 2 summarizes route coverage and question distributions.
blocks.zh: EgoGears利用人收集的室外自负中心录音来评价当地视频的理解和跨视频推理,这些记录跨越了不同的运动速度和照明条件. 图2总结了路线覆盖范围和问题分布.

blocks.en:
Source recordings and route coverage. The collection contains 126 126 recordings across 39 39 routes, totaling approximately 22.6 22.6 hours. It includes 88 88 daytime and 38 38 nighttime recordings, with 52 52 slow-walking, 32 32 fast-walking, and 42 42 running videos; 54 54 recordings follow out-and-back trajectories.
Of the 39 39 routes, 29 29 have multiple recordings, 35 35 include daytime observations, and 16 16 include nighttime observations. Movement and lighting coverage varies by route: 21 21 routes cover all three movement categories, while 12 12 include both lighting conditions and collectively cover all movement categories. Among these, 9 9 contain all six movement–lighting combinations, enabling comparisons of each movement category under both day and night conditions.
blocks.zh:
原始录音和路线覆盖。 馆藏有39条路线的126个126个录音,共计约22.6个22.6小时. 它包括88个88个白天和38个夜间录音,其中52个慢行道,32个快行道,42个跑道视频;54个录音跟随出道和回道.
在39条路线中,29条有多条录音,35条包括日间观察,16条包括夜间观察. 运动和取光覆盖率因路线而异:21 21道路线涵盖所有三个运动类别,而12道12道路线包含照明条件并集体涵盖所有运动类别. 其中,9 9 包含所有6个运动-照明组合,从而能够在昼夜条件下对每个运动类别进行比较。

blocks.en: Clip preparation. Evaluation clips are standardized to 480p H.264 with audio removed. Unique identifiers link each question to its visual evidence: one clip file for EgoGears-Single and a folder of question-specific clips for EgoGears-Multi.
blocks.zh: 剪接准备. 评价片段标准化为480p H.264,并去除音频. 独特的标识符将每个问题与它的视觉证据联系起来:一个EgoGears-Single的剪接文件和一个EgoGears-Multi的具体问题剪接文件夹.

blocks.en:
EgoGears-Multi. This subset contains 1,487 1{,}487 verified QA pairs with supporting evidence and explanations. Five input structures distinguish how evidence is distributed. Whole-video questions and questions using multiple clips from the same recording account for 64.29 % 64.29\% of the subset. The remaining 531 531 questions ( 35.71 % 35.71\% ) require correspondence across independent recordings through anonymous multi-clip inputs, explicit cross-video reasoning, or cross-recording comparisons.
The subset covers 29 29 fine-grained question types, including landmark order, turn-pattern comparison, event-to-route-phase alignment, spatial consistency, route summarization, and landmark revisits. These questions test whether models associate evidence with the correct observation and compose it into consistent spatial and temporal relations.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
EgoGears-Single. This subset contains 567 567 verified QA pairs, each grounded in one continuous clip: 540 540 question inputs are 60 60 seconds long, and 27 27 are shorter tail clips. It assesses local understanding without requiring cross-clip correspondence.
Questions span three core types: visually grounded QA ( 45.86 % 45.86\% ), spatiotemporal reasoning ( 33.69 % 33.69\% ), and trajectory QA ( 20.46 % 20.46\% ). Nine fine-grained categories further characterize capabilities, including object and attribute recognition, ego-relative spatial reasoning, trajectory understanding, ego-motion recognition, scene understanding, and OCR.

爱高吉星相. 这个子集包含567,567个已核实的QA对,每对被固定在一个连续片段:540,540个问题输入有60秒长,27个是更短的尾片片段. 它评估当地的理解,而不需要交叉剪接通信。
问题涉及三种核心类型:视基QA(45.86% 45.86 % ) 、 spatiental推理(33.69% 33.69 % ) 、 轨迹QA(20.46% 20.46 % ) 。 九个精细的类别进一步说明能力,包括物体和属性识别、自我相对空间推理、轨迹理解、自我运动识别、场景理解和OCR。

4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: Our experiments examine the transition from local video understanding to reliable comparison across encounters, focusing on evidence attribution, ordered route understanding, and the benefits and limitations of explicit reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验研究了从当地视频理解到跨接触的可靠比较的过渡,重点是证据归属,顺序路由理解,以及明确推理的好处和局限性.

blocks.en:
Experimental setup. We evaluate 29 29 single-video and 31 31 multi-video configurations across six MLLM families on EgoGears.
We use deterministically shuffled options, temperature-zero decoding, and a common structured-answer instruction.
The primary metric is fixed-denominator exact-set accuracy: invalid and unfinished outputs count as incorrect.
blocks.zh:
实验设置. 我们评价了EgoGears上的6个MLLM家庭的29个29个单视频和31个多视频配置。
我们使用决定性的洗涤方案, 温度零解码, 以及一个常见的结构化答案。
主要衡量标准是固定定分仪精确设定的准确性:无效和未完成的产出算作不正确。

blocks.en:
Local accuracy leaves cross-video reliability unresolved. Tables 3 and 3 reveal substantially different performance profiles across the two subsets.
Qwen3.5-27B-Thinking and Gemma-4-31B-Thinking achieve nearly identical single-video accuracy ( 68.6 % 68.6\% and 68.4 % 68.4\% ), but their multi-video scores differ by 15.4 15.4 percentage points ( 40.8 % 40.8\% versus 56.2 % 56.2\% ).
Both splits are drawn from the same recordings, and the gap is not an artifact of answer format or scoring: all 20 20 configurations evaluated on both splits remain lower on multi-video questions among single-choice questions (mean 14.6 14.6 points), among multi-select questions ( 20.4 20.4 ), and under partial credit ( 13.3 13.3 ; Appendix B.5 ). Local-video evaluation alone is therefore insufficient to assess reasoning across encounters.
blocks.zh:
局部准确性留下了交叉视频可靠性未解决. 表3和表3显示,两个子集的业绩情况大相径庭。
Quen3.5-27B-Thinking和Gemma-4-31B-Thinking实现几乎相同的单视频精度(68.6% 68.6\%和68.4% 68.4\%),但其多视频分数相差15.4 15.4个百分点(40.8% 40.8\%和56.2% 56.2\%).
两种分数均取自同一种录音,相差不是解答格式或分数的产物:在两种分数上评价的所有20个配置在单选题(平均14.6 14.6分),多选题(20.4 20.4分)和部分分数(13.3 13.3分;附录B.5.)的多视频问题上仍然较低. 因此,单靠地方-视频评价不足以评估各种接触之间的推理。

blocks.en:
Recording identity alone does not determine difficulty. Evidence from independent recordings is not uniformly harder than evidence from one recording.
Multi-caption questions draw all clips from one recording, yet 19 19 of the 31 31 configurations score higher on explicit cross-video questions; InternVL3.5-241B, for example, obtains 40.2 % 40.2\% versus 12.2 % 12.2\% .
Because the units differ in answer format (random exact accuracy 12.6 % 12.6\% versus 1.8 % 1.8\% ), we also compare chance-normalized accuracy κ \kappa (Appendix B.4 ).
The ordering still depends on the model: InternVL3.5, Qwen2.5-VL, and the direct-answer Qwen3-VL models remain stronger on cross-video questions (e.g., κ = 31.6 \kappa=31.6 versus 10.6 10.6 for InternVL3.5-241B), whereas Gemini and every Qwen3.5 configuration are stronger on multi-caption questions.
Which input structure is harder is therefore model-specific rather than determined by whether clips come from different recordings.
blocks.zh:
仅记录身份并不决定难度. 独立录音提供的证据并非总比一次录音提供的证据更难。
多标题问题从一个录音中抽取出所有剪辑,然而31个配置中,有19个在明显的交叉视频问题上得分较高;例如,InternVL3.5-241B获得40.2% 40.2\%对12.2% 12.2\%.
由于这些单位在答题格式上的差异(随机精确度为12.6% 12.6++++=1.8 % 1.8+++),我们还比较了概率规范化的精确度为\kappa(附录B.4.).
订单仍取决于型号: InternVL3.5, Quen2.5-VL, 和直答 Quen3-VL 型号在交叉视频问题上仍然更强 (如: ob = 31.6\kappa= 31.6 相对于 10.6 10.6 InternVL3.5-241B),而双子座和每个Quen3.5 配置在多封题上更强.
因此,哪个输入结构比较难,是针对模型的,而不是由剪辑是否来自不同的录音来决定的.

blocks.en: Effect of speed and lighting. On the 9 routes recorded under all six speed × \times lighting conditions, every comparison holds the route and wearer fixed (Fig. 3 ; 95% CIs in brackets). Darkness mainly affects perception: night-time changes single-video accuracy by − 8.0 -8.0 pp [ − 13.9 -13.9 , − 1.3 -1.3 ], with 28 of 29 models worse, but multi-video accuracy by only − 0.3 -0.3 pp [ − 3.3 -3.3 , 2.5 2.5 ] ( − 1.7 -1.7 pp on the full benchmark). As multi-video accuracy is already low, the smaller effect may partly reflect a floor. Running is the hardest condition: relative to fast walking it changes single-video accuracy by − 8.1 -8.1 pp [ − 15.3 -15.3 , − 0.4 -0.4 ], and relative to slow walking it changes multi-video accuracy by − 4.8 -4.8 pp [ − 8.4 -8.4 , − 1.3 -1.3 ].

blocks.en:
Ordered route understanding is weak even within one observation. The strongest single-video trajectory score is only 53.1 % 53.1\% , achieved by Qwen3.5-27B-Thinking, which reaches 75.4 % 75.4\% on ego-relative spatial relations.
Because 91 91 of the 96 96 trajectory questions are single-choice, this weakness cannot be attributed solely to exact multi-select evaluation.
blocks.zh:
有序的路线理解即使在一个观察中也是薄弱的. 最强单曲-视频轨迹得分仅为53.1% 53.1% 由Quen3.5-27B-Thinking所实现,在自负-相对空间关系上达到75.4% 75.4%.
由于96个96个轨迹问题中有91个91个是单选的,因此这一弱点不能完全归因于精确的多选评价.

blocks.en:
The same pattern recurs in multi-video evaluation (Table 6 ): turns and route shape form the weakest capability group for both Gemini-3.8-Flash ( 64.0 % 64.0\% ) and Gemma-4-31B-Thinking ( 36.8 % 36.8\% ), and Gemini-3.8-Flash obtains only 33.3 % 33.3\% on multi-step turning over whole-video evidence ( n = 87 n=87 ).
Such intersections are diagnostic only: several input–capability cells contain fewer than 20 20 questions, and 10 10 are empty.
Cross-video understanding thus depends on trajectory information that is already difficult to recover locally.
blocks.zh:
同样的模式在多视频评价中重复出现(表6):转弯和路由形状构成双子座-3.8-Flash(64.0% 64.0\%)和Gemma-4-31B-Thinking(36.8% 36.8\%)的最小能力组;双子座-3.8-Flash在多步骤翻转全视频证据时仅获得33.3% 33.3\%(n=87n=87).
这种相交只是诊断性:几个输入-能力细胞包含不到20个问题,10个是空的.
因此,跨视频理解取决于当地已经难以恢复的轨迹信息。

blocks.en:
Reasoning gains are selective across capabilities. Across the eight matched single-video comparisons in Table 3 , enabling reasoning improves every configuration, with a median gain of 7.8 7.8 percentage points.
The median gain is much larger for ego-relative spatial relations ( 14.0 14.0 points) than for trajectory understanding ( 3.7 3.7 points).
Similarly, Qwen3-VL-235B improves from 42.6 % 42.6\% to 64.0 % 64.0\% on multi-select questions but only from 60.6 % 60.6\% to 62.8 % 62.8\% on single-choice questions.
Reasoning thus appears to help verify candidate relations more than reconstruct ordered motion, although these comparisons also reflect the longer outputs of reasoning runs.
We restrict this controlled comparison to the single-video split.
blocks.zh:
合理收益是各种能力的选择性的。 在表3的8个对应单视频比较中,推理可以改进每个配置,中间增益为7.8 7.8个百分点。
自我相对空间关系的中位增益(14.0 14.0分)远大于轨迹理解(3.7 3.7分).
同样,在多选题上,Qune3-VL-235B从42.6% 42.6\%提高到64.0% 64.0\%,但在单选题上则从60.6% 60.6\%提高到62.8% 62.8\%.
因此,理由似乎有助于核实候选人关系,而不是重构命令动议,尽管这些比较也反映了推理结果较长。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced EgoGears, a benchmark of repeated outdoor egocentric traversals
that complements local video understanding with reasoning across encounters. Current
MLLMs perceive individual observations far better than they relate them: clip–evidence
binding and ordered route understanding remain key bottlenecks, and explicit
reasoning aids relation verification more than trajectory reconstruction.

blocks.en: Appendix A Societal Impact and Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录A 社会影响和限制

blocks.en: EgoGears evaluates whether multimodal models can relate egocentric observations of outdoor routes recorded while walking and running, under changes in speed, viewpoint, and illumination. Reliable models of this kind could support wearable route assistants, assistive navigation for people with visual impairments, place recognition for robots that learn from human route demonstrations, and the analysis of outdoor mobility. By separating local understanding from cross-video correspondence, the benchmark shows where current models fail, for example on ordered turns and on binding evidence to the correct clip, before such systems are deployed.
blocks.zh: EgoGears评价多式联运模式是否能够在速度、观点和照明的变化下,将记录在行走和运行过程中的户外路线的自我中心观测联系起来。 这种可靠的模型可以支持可穿戴的路由助手,为有视力障碍的人提供辅助导航,为从人类路由演示中学习的机器人进行定位识别,以及分析户外出行能力. 通过将本地理解与跨视频通信区分开来,基准显示当前模型在哪些地方失败,例如,在安装这些系统之前,在订购的转弯和对正确的剪辑具有约束力的证据方面。

blocks.en:
The same capabilities raise risks. Recordings made in public spaces may contain bystanders, vehicles, and private property. Released clips are downscaled to 480p without audio, and anonymized identifiers conceal participants, routes, and recording conditions.
Before release, faces and license plates will be blurred to reduce the identifiability of participants and incidental bystanders. Tasks that recognize the same place or route across recordings could, in principle, be used to infer where a person moves from videos they share. We therefore intend the benchmark for research on video understanding and not for surveillance or re-identification. In addition, higher accuracy on EgoGears does not show that a model is safe for real-time use: a wrong answer about a turn, an obstacle, or a crossing could endanger a pedestrian or runner. Deployment would require human oversight, calibrated uncertainty, and validation in the target environment.
blocks.zh:
同样的能力也增加了风险。 在公共场所制作的录音可以包括旁观者、车辆和私人财产。 释放的剪辑被缩小到480p,没有音频,匿名识别符隐藏参与者,路线,和记录条件.
在发行前,面相和牌照会模糊,以降低参与者和附带旁观者的可识别性. 原则上,承认同一地点或跨录音路线的任务可以用来推断一个人从他们分享的视频中移动的地点。 因此,我们打算以视频理解研究为基准,而不是用于监视或重新识别。 此外,EgoGears上更高的精度并不能表明一个模型是安全的实时使用:一个转弯错误的答案,一个障碍,或者一个过道会危及行人或跑道. 部署需要人员监督、调整不确定性和在目标环境中进行验证。

blocks.en: First, all 126 126 recordings come from a small number of participants and locations in one country, so they may not represent other regions, climates, terrains, body types, or recording devices. Second, the speed–lighting design is fully crossed on only 9 9 of the 39 39 routes, and night recordings cover 16 16 routes; the condition analysis in Figure 3 therefore rests on a small controlled subset and should be read as descriptive. Third, candidate questions were generated and partly verified with Gemini models, and Gemini also participated in adjudicating part of the multi-video set. Human review and the checks in Appendix C.6 reduce but do not eliminate residual label noise and possible model-specific bias. Fourth, results depend on the evaluation protocol: long reasoning outputs can be truncated, so some failures reflect incomplete outputs rather than a lack of understanding. Finally, the benchmark uses closed-set multiple-choice questions and offline clips; it does not evaluate open-ended answers or streaming, real-time interaction. Future work should extend the controlled design to more routes, participants, and regions, add conditions such as rain, snow, and crowded scenes, and evaluate models in open-ended and online settings.
blocks.zh: 首先,所有126个126个录音都来自一个国家的少数参与者和地点,因此它们可能不能代表其他地区,气候,地形,尸体类型,或录音装置. 其次,39条路线中只有9条完全跨越了速度灯设计,夜间录音覆盖了16条路线;因此,图3中的状况分析依赖于一个小的可控子集,应当理解为描述性。 第三,提出了候选问题,并与双子座模型进行了部分核实,双子座还参与了多视频集部分的裁判. 人文审查和附录C.6中的检查减少但不消除残留标签噪声和可能的模型特定偏差. 第四,结果取决于评价协议:长推理产出可以被截断,因此一些失败反映了产出不完整,而不是缺乏理解. 最后,该基准使用闭合-设置多选题和离线剪接;不评价开放式答案或流出,实时交互. 今后的工作应当将控制性设计扩大到更多的路线、参与者和区域,增加雨水、雪地和拥挤的场景等条件,并在开放式和在线环境下评价模型。

blocks.en: B.1 Models and Configurations

blocks.en: We evaluate configurations from the Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL, Qwen3.5, InternVL3.5, Gemma, GLM, Kimi-VL, together with three Gemini API models on the multi-video split. A configuration denotes a checkpoint and an inference mode, so reasoning-enabled and direct-answer modes of the same checkpoint are evaluated separately. The single-video leaderboard reports 29 configurations (Table 3 ). The multi-video leaderboard reports 31 configurations (Table 3 ): 3 Gemini API models, 18 open-source base runs, and 10 open-source explicit-reasoning runs. For the four checkpoints released only as Thinking models (Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking, Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking, GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking, and Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking-2506), we report only the explicit-reasoning run of each checkpoint.

blocks.en: B.2 Visual Input and Prompting
blocks.zh: B.2 视觉输入和提示

blocks.en: Models receive the evaluation clips of each question as images without audio. Non-contiguous clips and clips from different recordings remain separate rather than being concatenated into an artificial video. Each clip is introduced by an anonymized label.
blocks.zh: 模型作为没有音频的图像接收每个问题的评价片段. 来自不同录音的非相接相接的片段和片段仍然分开,而不是被收缩成人工视频. 每个片段由匿名标签引入.

blocks.en: Option order is deterministically shuffled using the question identifier and mapped back before scoring. All models receive the same question, shuffled options, and required selection count. The prompt instructs the model to use visual evidence, select exactly the requested number of options, and return only a JSON object of the form {"answer": [...]} . Decoding is deterministic with temperature zero. The multi-video prompt differs only in introducing each independent clip with its label; the single-video prompt states that the frames are in chronological order.
blocks.zh: 选项顺序使用问题标识符进行决定性的洗涤,并在打分前绘制回图. 所有模型都收到同样的问题,洗牌选项,并且需要选择计数. 即时指示模型使用视觉证据,准确选择所请求的选项数量,并只返回表单{"答案":[...]}的JSON对象. 解码以零温为定型. 多视频快讯仅在引入每个带有其标签的独立短片时有所不同;单视频快讯表示帧按时间顺序排列.

blocks.en: B.3 Inference and Answer Parsing
blocks.zh: B.3 推论和答案分析

blocks.en: The default model context length is 65,536 tokens. InternVL3.5 uses its 40,960-token limit. All InternVL3.5 models except 20B-A4B use one visual tile per image, because default dynamic tiling would exceed this limit.

blocks.en: B.7 Evaluation Taxonomies

blocks.en: Multi-video questions have two complementary classification axes. The unit axis describes how evidence is organized: whole-video, multi-caption multi-clip, anonymous multi-clip, cross-video, and cross-recording. Whole-video and multi-caption questions draw clips from one recording, whereas anonymous, cross-video, and cross-recording questions require evidence from independent recordings. The latter three units contain 531 questions in total.

blocks.en: Appendix C Collection and Quality-Control Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 收集和质量控制细节

blocks.en: C.1 Acquisition and Evidence Preparation
blocks.zh: C.1 获取和证据准备

blocks.en: Videos were captured using smartphones at 1080p and 30 30 fps. Participants mounted the phone at chest level, with its plane perpendicular to the ground and the camera facing forward. Collection instructions specified continuous sessions of at least 10 10 minutes. Route selection prioritized recognizable landmarks, limited pedestrian presence, and varied geometry, including straight segments, left and right turns, and U-turns.
blocks.zh: 视频在1080p和30fps使用智能手机被捕获. 与会者在胸口架起电话,其平面垂直于地上,镜头面向前方。 收集指令指定连续会议至少10分钟。 路由选择将可识别地标列为优先,行人在场有限,并有各种各样的几何特征,包括正段,左转和右转,和U转.

blocks.en: The acquisition protocol targeted repeated traversals across movement and lighting conditions. Realized coverage is partial: 54 54 recordings are explicitly identified as out-and-back traversals, and 9 9 routes cover all six movement–lighting combinations.
blocks.zh: 采购协议针对反复穿越移动和照明条件。 已实现的覆盖面是部分的:54个录音被明确定为出后转盘,9个路线涵盖所有6个运动-照明组合。

blocks.en: Evaluation clips are encoded as 480p H.264 video with audio removed. Evidence preparation follows each question’s temporal scope: continuous excerpts are extracted directly, while questions about complete recordings may use multiple evidence windows from the same source. Non-contiguous windows and clips from independent recordings remain separate files.
blocks.zh: 评价片段被编码为480p H.264视频并删除音频. 证据的准备遵循每个问题的时间范围:连续摘录直接取出,而关于完整录音的问题可能利用同一来源的多个证据窗口。 非相接的窗口和独立录音的片段仍然是单独的文件.

blocks.en: Anonymized clip labels and paths conceal original filenames, participant identities, route identifiers, movement and lighting metadata, and recording identities. Internal mappings retain the association between each question, its source recordings, and its evidence windows.
blocks.zh: 匿名的剪辑标签和路径隐藏了原始文件名、参与者身份、路线标识符、移动和照明元数据以及记录身份。 内部绘图保留了每个问题、其来源录音和证据窗口之间的联系。

blocks.en: C.2 Model-Assisted Candidate Generation
blocks.zh: C.2 获得模式支持的一代候选人

blocks.en: We use gemini-3.1-pro-preview for video observation and visual verification. For EgoGears-Multi, gemini-3.5-flash generates question stems, options, proposed answers, question types, and evidence ranges from the structured observations. For EgoGears-Single, gemini-3.1-pro-preview generates both captions and candidate questions. Text-only screening uses gemini-3.5-flash throughout.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Gemini -3.1 - 预留 视频观察和视觉验证。 对于"EgoGears-Multius","Gemini-3.5-flash"生成了问题源,选项,拟议答案,问题类型,证据从结构化的观测中可以得出. 对于EgoGears-Single,Gemini-3.1-pro-review同时生成标题和候选问题. 只有文字的筛选在整个过程中都使用基因3.5-发光.

blocks.en: For EgoGears-Multi, observation scope follows the question: complete recordings support global route questions, continuous excerpts support local temporal questions, and joint observations of independent recordings support cross-video comparisons. Segment-based generation uses clips at multiple temporal scales, including 60 60 and 180 180 seconds. Structured observations describe route phases, turns, landmarks, repeated places, dynamic events, environmental changes, and spatial relations. This process produces approximately 11,802 11{,}802 candidate questions.
blocks.zh: 对于"EgoGears-Multius",观测范围随题而来:完整录音支持全球路由问题,连续摘录支持局部时间问题,独立录音的联合观测支持交叉视频比较. 分段生成使用多时尺度的剪辑,包括60个60和180个180秒. 结构化观测描述了路由相,转弯,地标,重复地段,动态事件,环境变化,以及空间关系. 这一过程产生了大约11,802个11{,}802个候选问题。

blocks.en: For EgoGears-Single, recordings are divided into 60 60 -second clips, retaining shorter tail clips. Each clip receives a visually grounded caption with structured fields for the environment, objects and attributes, spatial relations, camera trajectories, and events. Candidate questions are generated from these descriptions.
blocks.zh: 对于"EgoGears-Single",录音分为60-60秒片段,保留更短的尾片片段. 每个片段都有一个可视化字幕,其中包含环境、物体和属性、空间关系、相机轨迹和事件的结构化领域。 候选人的问题来自这些说明。

blocks.en: C.3 Automated Screening for EgoGears-Multi
blocks.zh: C.3. EgoGears-多功能自动筛选

blocks.en: These candidates pass a five-stage procedure: 1. Deterministic option shuffling. Option positions are randomized using a stable procedure. 2. Structural validation. Checks enforce consistency among the stem, options, answer labels, question type, and selection count, and reject duplicate options. 3. Leakage screening. Questions are screened for identifying metadata, internal annotation fields, caption-derived cues, and timestamps that reveal the answer. 4. Text-only screening. The text-only model answers each question three times without video. A question is flagged if at least two responses match the proposed answer, triggering rejection or rewriting. This is a heuristic screen for language or option-structure shortcuts. 5. Video-grounded verification. The video model checks the required footage against every option, identifying unsupported claims, directional errors, and inconsistencies between the question and its evidence.
blocks.zh: 这些候选人通过了五个阶段的程序: 1. 确定选择权。 选择位置采用稳定程序随机排列。 2. 结构验证。 检查在干线、选项、回答标签、提问类型和选择计数之间执行一致性,并拒绝重复选项。 3. 渗出检查。 对问题进行筛选,以查明元数据、内部注释字段、字幕提示和揭示答案的时间戳。 4. 仅限文本放映。 仅限文本的模型在没有视频的情况下三次回答每个问题. 如果至少两个答复与拟议的答案相符,引发拒绝或重写,就会标出问题。 这是一个用于语言或选项结构快捷键的高压屏幕 。 5. 录像核查。 视频模型对照每个选项检查所需镜头,找出无佐证的主张,方向错误,以及问题与证据不一致之处.

blocks.en: Leakage screening. Questions are screened for identifying metadata, internal annotation fields, caption-derived cues, and timestamps that reveal the answer.

blocks.en: Text-only screening. The text-only model answers each question three times without video. A question is flagged if at least two responses match the proposed answer, triggering rejection or rewriting. This is a heuristic screen for language or option-structure shortcuts.
blocks.zh: 仅限文本筛选. 仅限文本的模型在没有视频的情况下三次回答每个问题. 如果至少两个答复与拟议的答案相符,引发拒绝或重写,就会标出问题。 这是一个用于语言或选项结构快捷键的高压屏幕 。

blocks.en: Video-grounded verification. The video model checks the required footage against every option, identifying unsupported claims, directional errors, and inconsistencies between the question and its evidence.
blocks.zh: 视频验证. 视频模型对照每个选项检查所需镜头,找出无佐证的主张,方向错误,以及问题与证据不一致之处.

blocks.en: These candidates pass an eight-stage procedure: 1. Comparison requirement. The question must belong to an allowed task type, contain sufficient clips, and require reasoning across multiple evidence windows. 2. Option structure. Checks examine option and answer counts, option length, and information density for superficial answer cues. 3. Leakage screening. Identifying metadata, internal fields, and description-dependent wording such as according to the description are screened out. 4. Deterministic shuffling. Options and clip display order are randomized so that answer positions and alphabetic clip labels do not encode the intended relation. 5. Cross-batch deduplication. Checks identify exact and near-duplicate stems, repeated evidence patterns, and duplicate question signatures. 6. Text-only screening and rewriting. Candidates undergo the three-attempt text-only test. Flagged questions may be rewritten and retested; persistently guessable questions are removed. 7. Evidence availability. Required recordings and time ranges must be valid, extractable, and sufficient for review. 8. Answer-blind visual verification. The video model receives the question and evidence without captions or proposed answers and labels each option as supported , ruled_out , or undecidable . Acceptance requires sufficient evidence and agreement between the supported-option set and the proposed answer.
blocks.zh: 这些候选人通过了八阶段程序: 1. 比较要求。 这个问题必须属于允许的任务类型,包含足够的剪辑,并且需要跨多个证据窗口的推理. 2. 备选结构。 检查检查选项和答案计数、选项长度以及信息密度以获取表面答案提示 。 3. 渗出检查。 确定元数据、内部字段和根据描述等依赖描述的措辞被剔除。 4. 有决断之乱. 选项和剪辑显示顺序是随机的,这样答案位置和字母剪辑标签就不会编码预定的关系. 5.相接分出. 检查确定准确和近似重复的根,重复的证据模式,并重复提问签名. 6. 仅限文本筛选和改写。 考生接受"三试一试"仅限文字测试. 标有标记的问题可以被重写并重新测试;持续可猜的问题被去掉. 7. 证据的提供。 所要求的录音和时间范围必须有效、可提取并足以审查。 8. 答-盲目视觉核查。 视频模型接收问题和证据时没有标题,也没有提出答案,并且将每个选项标注为支持的,排除的,或不可决定的. 接受要求有充分的证据,并且支持的一套办法和提议的答案之间必须达成协议。

blocks.en: Shuffling precedes text-only screening, and inexpensive structural and textual checks precede video verification. Automated screening produces a human-review package of 1,526 1{,}526 questions.

blocks.en: C.4 Verification and Sampling for EgoGears-Single
blocks.zh: C.4 EgoGears-Single的核查和抽样

blocks.en: Candidate questions undergo the same three-attempt text-only screening, with rewriting and retesting when necessary. The resulting pool contains 6,770 6{,}770 questions, averaging 4.8 4.8 questions per clip. Removing 318 318 questions associated with unsuitable clips, including truncated footage or insufficient visual evidence, leaves 6,452 6{,}452 candidates.
blocks.zh: 候选人的问题进行同样的三试只限文本的筛选,必要时进行重写和再测试. 由此形成的集合包含6,770个6{,}770个问题,平均每段4.8个问题. 删除318 318个与不适当的剪辑相关的问题,包括短片或视觉证据不足,留下6 452 6{,}452名候选人。

blocks.en: Each question receives one primary label from nine categories: 1. Text and OCR: reading visible text, numbers, or signs. 2. Temporal Grounding: identifying when an event or object appears. 3. Event Sequencing: ordering events, landmarks, or actions. 4. Scene and Place QA: recognizing environmental and place properties. 5. Object and Attribute QA: identifying objects and their static attributes. 6. Ego-relative Spatial Relation: locating entities relative to the camera or route. 7. Trajectory-grounded QA: understanding overall paths, travel directions, and turn sequences. 8. Ego-motion Recognition: recognizing local camera or wearer motion. 9. Actor Action and Motion: recognizing the actions of external entities.
blocks.zh: 每个问题都从9个类别获得一个主要标签: 1. 文本和OCR:读取可见文本、数字或标志。 2. 时间定位:确定事件或物体何时出现。 3. 事件顺序:订购事件、地标或行动。 4. 场景和地点:承认环境和地点属性。 5. 物体和属性 QA:识别物体及其静态属性. 6. 电子相对空间关系:查找与相机或路线相接的实体。 7. 轨迹定位质量保证:了解总体路径、出行方向和转动顺序。 8. 电子运动识别:识别本地相机或穿戴者运动. 9. 演员行动和动议:承认外部实体的行动。

blocks.zh: 轨迹定位QA:理解整体路径,出行方向,并转动序列.

blocks.zh: Ego-motion识别:识别本地相机或穿戴者运动.

blocks.en: The classifier first uses question form to identify OCR, temporal-grounding, and sequencing questions. Other categories use alignment between the proposed correct options and caption fields. Motion questions are distinguished by whether they concern the overall route, local camera motion, or external actors. Spatial-versus-attribute ambiguity is further examined using the objects mentioned in distractors and captions; unresolved cases default to Object and Attribute QA.
blocks.zh: 分级者首先使用问询表来识别OCR,时间定位和排序问题. 其他类别使用拟议正确选项和标题字段之间的对齐。 动议问题有区别,是涉及整体路线,局部相机运动,还是外部角色. 利用分流器和标题中提到的物体,进一步审查空间与属性之间的模糊性;未解决的案件默认为对象和属性QA。

blocks.en: The verifier receives the clip, question, options, and proposed answer; captions are withheld. It assigns option-level support labels and records evidence time ranges. A question is labeled answer_correct when all proposed correct options are supported and distractors are ruled out or undecidable. It is labeled answer_wrong when a proposed correct option is contradicted or a distractor is supported, and insufficient when the evidence is inadequate.
blocks.zh: 核查人收到剪辑、提问、选项和拟议答案;不附加标题。 它指定了选项级支持标签并记录了证据时间范围. 当所有建议正确的选项都得到支持,并且排除了分心器或无法解析时,一个问题被标记为答案_正确. 当提议的正确选项相矛盾或支持分心者时,它被贴上标签的回答_错误,当证据不足时则不充分。

blocks.en: Verification of all 6,452 6{,}452 candidates yields 5,081 5{,}081 answer_correct , 1,364 1{,}364 answer_wrong , and 7 7 insufficient outcomes.

Only answer_correct candidates enter quota-based sampling, targeting approximately 700 700 questions across the nine categories. Larger categories are capped, while categories below quota contribute all passing questions. Sampling uses a fixed random seed and a strict limit of 15 15 questions per source recording. Clip reuse is avoided where possible; this preference may be relaxed to fill quotas, while the recording-level cap remains fixed. The resulting 698 698 questions proceed to human review.
blocks.zh: 只有回答/正确候选人进入基于配额的抽样,针对9个类别的大约700个问题。 较大的类别是上限,而低于配额的类别是所有通过的问题。 采样使用固定的随机种子并严格限定每出源记录15个15个问题. 在可能时避免了剪切再利用;这种偏好可以放宽以填补配额,而记录级别上限保持不变. 由此产生的698,698个问题进入人文审查。

blocks.en: C.5 Human Review, Adjudication, and Release
blocks.zh: C.5 人文审查、判决和释放

blocks.en: Each subset’s review package is divided into ten batches assigned to ten annotators. For EgoGears-Multi, proposed answers are withheld. Reviewers inspect every associated clip, construct separate clip timelines, and label each option as supported , ruled_out , or undecidable . They provide an answer, a clarity judgment, and notes on problematic options. Clip labels are not treated as chronological cues, and place correspondence is assessed using stable structures such as road geometry, building shapes, and fixed installations.
blocks.zh: 每个子集的审查包分为十个批次,分配给十个注释员。 对于EgoGears-Multi,建议的答复不予答复。 审查者检查每个相关的剪辑,构建单独的剪辑时间段,并将每个选项标注为支持,排除,或不可决定. 它们提供了一个答案、一个明确的判断,并且指出了有问题的选择。 剪贴标签不作为时间提示对待,并使用道路几何、建筑形状和固定装置等稳定结构来评估位置通信。

blocks.en: EgoGears-Single review focuses on local visual facts, including objects, spatial relations, camera motion, event order, and environmental changes. Reviewers document the validity of questions and options against the footage.
blocks.zh: EgoGears-Single评论侧重于局部视觉事实,包括物体,空间关系,相机运动,事件顺序,以及环境变化等. 评论员对照镜头记录问题和选项的有效性.

blocks.en: Following human review, the video model reassesses options without the proposed answer, and the text-only model repeats shortcut screening. Adjudication combines available human judgments, visual verification, text-only results, and proposed answers to retain, revise, repair, or remove questions. Repairs address answer errors, ambiguous wording, incomplete option sets, or insufficient evidence. Repaired questions undergo renewed visual verification and text-only screening.
blocks.zh: 人文审查后,视频模型在没有拟议答案的情况下重新评估选项,只文本模型重复了快捷键筛选. 判断结合了现有的人文判断,可视性验证,只文本结果,并提出了保留,修改,修复或去除问题的答案. 修复工作涉及回答错误、措辞模糊、选项集不完整或证据不足。 修复后的问题需要重新进行视觉核查和只检查文本。

blocks.en: Of the 1,526 1{,}526 EgoGears-Multi review items, 706 706 are confirmed, 504 504 pass repair, 277 277 receive answer changes through adjudication, and 39 39 are removed, yielding 1,487 1{,}487 released questions.
blocks.zh: 在1,526 1{,}526 EgoGears-Multi审查项目中,706,706项得到确认,504,504次通行证修理,277,277次通过裁定获得答复变更,39个被删除,得出1,487 1{,}487个解答问题。

blocks.en: For EgoGears-Single, 567 567 of the 698 698 reviewed candidates are retained: 562 562 have complete human annotations, while 5 5 are retained through video-based verification without complete human annotations. The audit records 120 120 answer modifications, 3 3 question modifications, and 3 3 option modifications. These modifications correct errors in the model-generated candidates; each modified question was re-verified against the footage before release, so the rates describe the candidate pool rather than the released labels.
blocks.zh: 对于"EgoGears-Single",698名698名被评选的候选人中,有567 567人被保留:562 562人拥有完整的人文说明,而5人则通过视频核查而保留,而没有完整的人文说明. 审计记录120,120个回答修改,3个问题修改,3个选项修改. 这些修改纠正了模型所生成候选人的错误;每个被修改的问题在发布前都根据镜头重新核实,因此收费率描述的是候选人池而非所发布的标签.

blocks.en: C.6 Reproducibility and Validity Checks
blocks.zh: C.6 可复制性和有效性检查

blocks.en: We independently rescore every per-question result of the 29 reported single-video configurations using the strict parser and recover the originally reported scores exactly. The dataset and prompt are locked by hashes in each run configuration. We also repeat Qwen3-VL-8B on a separate cluster: the direct-answer run obtains 40.9% versus 40.7% in the original environment, while the reasoning run obtains 51.0% versus 52.6%. The latter difference is explained mainly by a higher residual truncation count (60 versus 38), again emphasizing that serving conditions interact with long reasoning outputs.
blocks.zh: 我们使用严格的解析器,独立地对29个报道的单视频配置的每个问题结果进行回溯,并准确恢复最初报告的分数。 数据集和即时被散列锁定在每个运行配置中. 我们还在单独的集群上重复了Qune3-VL-8B:直接回答运行在原始环境中获得40.9%对40.7%,而推理运行获得51.0%对52.6%. 造成后一差异的主要原因是剩余调值计数较高(60比38),再次强调服务条件与长期推理产出相互作用。

blocks.en: Finally, we check whether Gemini’s participation in adjudicating 322 multi-video questions explains its lead. Within matched question units, this contributes an estimated 1.5 points to overall Gemini accuracy, far smaller than the 22.1-point gap between Gemini-3.8-Flash and the strongest open model. Table 7 reports all configurations on the 445 questions whose reference answers human reviewers confirmed (65 of them after option repair). On this subset, the Gemini models average 80.9%, compared with 34.0% across the 28 open-source configurations; Gemini-3.8-Flash leads the strongest open model by 20.5 points (22.1 on the full set), and the ranking of configurations is nearly unchanged (Spearman ρ = 0.99 \rho=0.99 ). Gemini’s lead is therefore unlikely to be explained by its role in adjudication. The Gemini models receive the same visual input, prompt, and option shuffling as the open-source models.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们检查双子座参与裁决322个多视频问题是否解释了它的领导地位。 在匹配的问号单元内,这为双子座整体精度贡献了约1.5分,远小于双子座-3.8-Flash与最强开放模型之间的22.1分差距. 表7报告了445个问题的所有配置,其中参考答复人类审查员确认(其中65个在选项修复后)。 在这个子集上,双子座模型平均为80.9%,而整个28个开源配置的34.0%;双子座-3.8-Flash以20.5分(全集22.1分)领先最强开源模型,配置的排名几乎保持不变(Spearman à = 0.99\rho=0.99). 因此,双子星的领先地位不可能由它在裁决中的作用来解释。 双子座模型接收到与开源模型相同的视觉输入,即时,和可选打乱.

blocks.en: Table 7: Multi-video exact accuracy on human-confirmed questions (%). All: the full set ( N = 1,487 N=1{,}487 , as in Table 3 ). Human: the 445 445 questions whose reference answers the reviewers confirmed ( 65 65 after option repair), with 95 % 95\% bootstrap confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 表7:人类确认问题的多视频准确性(%)。 所有:完整套(N=1 487 N=1{,}487),如表3. 人类:有445,445个问题,而审查者对这些问题的答复证实了(在选项修复后65个问题),95% 95 % 的靴子置信间隔。

blocks.en: Cross-recording comparison adds viewpoint reversal and correspondence uncertainty. In Figure 5 (a), the recordings depict the same intersection, but the correct answer requires reversing the travel-direction-dependent relation while preserving the building identity. Gemma-4-31B is corrected, whereas Qwen3-VL-235B remains inconsistent after reasoning. Panel (b) combines landmark side with within-clip order; only the strongest displayed configuration produces the exact set. These examples show that recognizing shared visual content is insufficient: all selected propositions must be expressed in one consistent coordinate and temporal frame.
blocks.zh: 交叉记录比较增加了观点倒转和函证不确定性. 在图5 (a)中,录音描绘了相同的交叉口,但正确答案需要扭转旅行方向依赖关系,同时保留建筑身份. Gemma-4-31B被更正,而Quen3-VL-235B在推理后仍然不一致. 面板 (b) 将地标侧与内剪接顺序相结合;只有最强显示的配置产生精确的组合. 这些例子表明,承认共同的视觉内容是不够的:所有选定的命题都必须用一致的坐标和时间框架来表达。

blocks.en: Figure 6 presents a complementary whole-video failure. Determining whether the endpoint returns near the start requires linking distant observations and selecting the landmark that establishes the match. Qwen3-VL-235B succeeds in both modes, while Gemma-4-31B and Gemini-3.1-Pro select the same incorrect alternative. The stable model-specific outcomes suggest that additional reasoning is useful only after the start and end observations have been encoded as comparable place representations.
blocks.zh: 图6显示的是补充性的全视频故障。 确定端点是否在起始点附近返回,需要将远程观测连接起来,并选择确定匹配的地标. Qune3-VL-235B在两种模式中都成功,而Gemma-4-31B和双子座-3.1-Pro选择了相同的不正确的替代品. 稳定的模型特定结果表明,只有在开始和结束观测被编码为可比位置表示之后,额外推理才有用。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Cross-recording side and order reasoning. The same physical structures must be aligned across observations before direction-dependent relations can be reversed and combined consistently.
blocks.zh: 图5:交叉记录和顺序推理。 同样的实体结构必须在各种观察中保持一致,然后才能扭转和始终如一地合并依赖方向的关系。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Whole-video start–end correspondence. The models must match distant route phases through a shared landmark; reasoning leaves both the correct and incorrect model predictions unchanged.
blocks.zh: 图6:全视始发-终发通信. 这些模型必须通过一个共同的地标来匹配遥远的路由阶段;推理使模型的正确和不正确的预测保持不变.

blocks.en: C.7 Additional Computation Can Rescue or Destabilize Predictions
blocks.zh: C.7 额外计算可拯救或破坏预测

blocks.en: Figures 7 – 9 compare cases in which reasoning helps, has no effect, or damages an initially correct answer. Figure 7 is especially instructive because each panel contains both directions of change. In the spatial example, reasoning corrects Qwen3-VL-235B but causes GLM-4.6V to replace the correct set with two unsupported objects; Qwen3.5-122B remains correct. In the trajectory example, Qwen3.5-27B and Gemma-4-31B are rescued, whereas GLM-4.6V changes from the correct endpoint description to an incorrect dead-end interpretation. This pattern is inconsistent with a simple rule that more computation monotonically improves visual reasoning.
blocks.zh: 图7-9比较了推理有助于、没有效果或损害最初正确答案的案例。 图7特别具有启发性,因为每个小组都包含两个变化方向。 在空间示例中,推理纠正了Quen3-VL-235B,但导致GLM-4.6V将正确的集合替换为两个不支持的对象;而Quen3.5-122B仍然正确. 在轨迹例子中,Qwen3.5-27B和Gemma-4-31B被救出,而GLM-4.6V则从正确的端点描述转变为错误的死端解释. 这种模式不符合一个简单的规则,即更多的计算能单调地改善视觉推理.

blocks.en: The same instability appears in multi-video QA. In Figure 8 (a), reasoning rescues Gemma-4-31B but leads GLM-4.6V away from an exact direct answer and does not resolve Qwen3-VL-235B. Panel (b) shows a second GLM regression alongside a stable correct Qwen prediction. Figure 9 (a) again contrasts a successful GLM correction with an unresolved Qwen3-VL error. Its panel (b) is a limiting case: two models fail in both modes on an apparently simple “no turns” relation, while Qwen3.5-122B is correct in both. Here, reasoning cannot compensate for an incorrect segmentation of route events.
blocks.zh: 同样的不稳定出现在多视频QA中. 在图8 (a)中,推理救出Gemma-4-31B,但引导GLM-4.6V远离一个准确的直接答案,并不能解决Qune3-VL-235B. 小组(b)显示第二个GLM回归,同时显示一个稳定的正确的Quen预测。 图9(a)再次将成功的GLM校正与未解决的Qwen3-VL出错作对比. 它的面板(b)是一个有限度的案例:两种模式在表面上简单的“不转弯”关系上都失败了,而Quen3.5-122B两种模式都是正确的。 在这里,推理不能弥补路线事件不正确的分化.

blocks.en: Across these examples, explicit reasoning behaves primarily as an evidence-selection and consistency mechanism, not as a guaranteed source of new visual information. It helps when the required facts are present, but a direct answer binds them to the wrong option, side, or clip. It fails when motion evidence is missing, place correspondence is not established, or the trace introduces an unsupported reinterpretation. This explains why the aggregate gain can coexist with substantial per-instance regressions.
blocks.zh: 在这些例子中,明确的推理主要表现为证据选择和一致性机制,而不是新视觉信息的可靠来源。 当需要的事实存在时,它会有所帮助,但直接的答案却将它们与错误的选择、侧面或片段联系在一起。 当动议证据缺失,无法确定通信位置,或者跟踪引入了不支持的再解释时,它就失败了. 因此,总收益可以与实质性的逐项回归并存。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Single-video cases where reasoning has opposite effects across models. Correct direct answers may be destabilized even when another model is rescued on the same question.
blocks.zh: 图7:推理在模型中产生相反效果的单视频案例. 即使在同一问题上拯救了另一个模型,正确的直接答案也可能不稳定。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Multi-video regressions and corrections under reasoning. The intervention can improve evidence binding for one model while inducing an inconsistent or wrong-cardinality answer in another.
blocks.zh: 图8:推理下的多视频回归与更正. 这种干预可以改进对一种模式有约束力的证据,同时在另一种模式中诱导不一致或错误的心律答案。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Reasoning rescue versus persistent failure in multi-video QA. Panel (a) contrasts successful and unsuccessful cross-clip evidence integration; panel (b) shows that added computation does not repair an incorrectly inferred turn sequence.
blocks.zh: 图9:多视频QA中救援理由与持续故障. 小组 (a) 对比成功和不成功的交叉剪切证据整合;小组 (b) 显示所添加的计算无法修复错误地推断的转弯顺序。
